title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #166 · 교복 · 스카프 탑 × 치어리더 플레어 초미니 · 극단 플랫폼 블랙 하이탑 · 지그재그 홈 · siren bust hourglass · 손허리·턱 · 배경 수영장 · 코갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered honey blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a scarf top made from a navy-bordered white triangular school scarf of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey folded around her bust, tied behind her neck and back, with its front corners knotted at the center of her chest under a small gold school pin and the two short ends hanging down, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and an ultra-micro flared cheerleader skirt of ultra-thin matte forest-green modal jersey with a white trim along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones and flaring outward with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones, the matching micro briefs of the same fabric peeking beneath the hem. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the flared cheerleader skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: platform shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, black leather high-top sneakers with red laces, each built on a towering solid black rubber platform sole taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee, its tall side wall decorated with a deep zigzag groove sculpted into the cushioned midsole running along the whole length of the side wall with sharp even peaks, worn with red-and-white striped knee-high socks, her feet held level on the flat tops of the platforms, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in forest green lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a bright indoor swimming pool hall with pale tiled floors, a pool edge, standard-height steps and tall windows full of daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
